description: The original stores each tee / flag sheet cell into 0x00822b84 (g_map822b80[1]) before its addSprite (0x0045776c tee, 0x00457915 flag); buyland.cpp's twin loop stores it too. The port's routing map writes it in neither path: its drawing calls (MapDraw) run only with a backend, and a drawing pass leaves the GameState as it was, and its simulation path never had the store. g_map822b80 is class `engine`, never compared by the segment or boot gates, so the difference is unmeasured, not shown harmless: no reader of 0x00822b84 outside the screens that store it was looked for.
needed: a reader census of 0x00822b84 (re/model inventory) decides whether the sim path needs the store

description: A boot run's last frame (no FRAME record follows it) did not make TraceInput's tail idle passes, which only the boot of a trace with no frame head had: past the frame's last dispatch the first Blocking pump threw NeedInput. cov_a_champ answers `Yes, cancel.` with its last dispatch, so the port left the frame for the title menu and stopped at the hover loop's first pumpMessages (tick_menu.inc hover_loop), before View_toLocal, the redraw and Window::refreshFull: n_yes / end showed the cancel prompt (479,920 px). The original's title loop made 1,120 more passes (the trace's unread CURSOR records, one View_toLocal each). With tail idle on the last frame both PASS 0 px; control tick.frame 13 (off) brings the 479,920 px back. What it changes elsewhere: only the part of a boot run after its last FRAME record (no frame record is compared there); the idle passes end at the last unread CURSOR record as in the no-frame-head boot (S2.4 / phase 5). Measured on cov_a_champ, cov_a_keys, cov_a_build, cov_a_career, cov_b_decor, ui_tour, ui_tour_v (framegate) and by the boot gate (17_notes.md).
